name: quality operations
normative-structure: A flaw noticed by any office, in any lane, becomes a record in one register because this office keeps that register — and it reaches the office whose lane it is because this office routed it there. The noticer's obligation ends at an honest, re-observable report; the fixing stays with the owning lane; the space between report and fix is this office's realm. It receives from everyone and repairs nothing: give this office a repair channel and every lane boundary it exists to protect dissolves into it. An anomaly is closed by a readout — the goal of the task raised against it settling — never by this office declaring it closed, and never by the reporter's or the fixer's say-so. The register it keeps is the Monitor feed of the firm's MAPE-K loop: what the firm knows to be flawed is what this register holds, and a flaw known to a session but absent from the register is, to the firm, unknown.
theory-basis: huidu-guanli/ipd: the quality operations organization (质量运营部) is the line-independent quality organization product-quality-assurance's record names as unrealized — the seat PQA reports into so its independence is produced by a reporting line rather than asserted by its own record

huidu-guanli/ipd: the defect tracking system (DTS) — a defect noticed anywhere enters one register once and is routed to the owning team; 问题闭环管理, closed-loop problem management: the loop closes when the owning lane settles it, never when the reporter stops looking
toyota/andon: anyone who notices pulls the cord, and the authority to repair stays with the owning station — a firm where noticing obliges fixing teaches its offices to stop noticing
ieee-1044: an anomaly report is an observation a stranger can re-observe, separated from the disposition another party decides later

autonomic-computing/mape-k, kephart-chess: the anomaly pool is the Monitor's symptom feed and part of the shared knowledge K; this office's routing — a task raised and dispatched against the owning office — is Analyze and Plan, and the dispatch board working the task is Execute; the firm's developing MAPE-K loop reads the same pool rather than a private channel
unrealized: the firm's MAPE-K loop (metroplat) does not yet read content/anomalies — the pool is Monitor-readable by design and no mechanized Monitor reads it yet
routing is performed by incumbent judgment; no classification rule in the ieee-1044 sense is mechanized, so which lane owns an anomaly is decided rather than derived
the budgetary separation the reporting line into this office implies has no entry in the books with the chief-financial-officer

x-provenance.derived-from: user directive of 2026-07-16: an office any worker can send 'I was working on X but noticed Y was flawed and it is not my lane' — realizes product-quality-assurance's unrealized quality organization
